headword: {中間試験|ちゅうかんしけん}

definitions.explanation: An examination held in the middle of an academic term to assess students' progress partway through the course.

examples.japanese: {中間試験|ちゅうかんしけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{返|かえ}ってきた→返る：29164_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: The midterm exam results came back.

examples.japanese: {中間試験|ちゅうかんしけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{期末|きまつ}→期末：22375_kimatsu⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧。
examples.english: The midterm covers less material than the final.

examples.japanese: {中間試験|ちゅうかんしけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{期末|きまつ}→期末：22375_kimatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{挽回|ばんかい}→挽回：16313_bankai⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I got a bad grade on the midterm, so I want to make up for it on the final.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{中間|ちゅうかん}→中間：05458_chuukan⟧ (middle, midway) + ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (exam)

USAGE:
Typically held about halfway through each school term. The material covered is usually the first half of the term's content, so its ⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧ is narrower than a ⟦{期末試験|きまつしけん}→期末試験：06690_kimatsushiken⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{期末試験|きまつしけん}→期末試験：06690_kimatsushiken⟧ - final exam
- ⟦{追試験|ついしけん}→追試験：06692_tsuishiken⟧ - makeup exam
- ⟦{小|しょう}テスト→小テスト：27557_shoutesuto⟧ - quiz, short test

COLLOQUIAL:
Often shortened to:
- ⟦{中間|ちゅうかん}→中間：05458_chuukan⟧ (midterms)
- ⟦{中間|ちゅうかん}→中間：05458_chuukan⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧ (midterm test)
